info.title: edgar-sidecar
info.summary: HTTP wrapper around edgartools - the single SEC egress

Address.title: Address
Address.description:
One address shape for every source. The submissions store carries the country
description; the SGML header parse does not and serves it as null.

AttachmentInfo.title: AttachmentInfo
AttachmentInfo.description: One submission document; richer than the envelope's lean DocumentRef.

Auditor.title: Auditor
Auditor.description:
One audit firm from the XBRL DEI facts. A filing carries several when it reports an
auditor change -- current + prior, each tagged on its own period context.

BeneficialOwner.title: BeneficialOwner
BeneficialOwner.description:
One reporting person from the cover page (joint filers -> multiple).

13G never carries the person CIK on the cover page (always null); 13D usually does.

CompanyProfile.title: CompanyProfile
CompanyProfile.description: Everything the SEC submissions JSON says about the entity - no cross-filing fetches.

CurrentPageSize.title: CurrentPageSize
CurrentPageSize.description: The getcurrent feed only serves these page sizes; anything else would be silently clamped.

DRSData.title: DRSData
DRSData.description: filing.obj() for a DRS / DRS/A -- the edgar DraftRegistrationStatement, full fidelity.

DocumentRef.title: DocumentRef
DocumentRef.description:
A lean reference to one filing attachment (primary document or content exhibit).

Shared by the envelope's primary_documents and the current-report forms' exhibits -
one shape for "a submission document", content fetched separately via /attachments/{seq}.

EightKData.title: EightKData
EightKData.description: filing.obj() for an 8-K -- the edgar CurrentReport, full structural fidelity.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
Canonical body for every non-2xx the sidecar emits (HTTPException, mapped
edgartools/httpx exceptions, and flattened request-validation errors alike).

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: One financial fact, every public surface of FinancialFact preserved.

FactsResponse.title: FactsResponse
FactsResponse.description:
Paged facts for one entity; shape mirrors SubmissionsPage (start/page_size in,
has_more/next_start out). Used by /facts, /facts/concept/{c}, /facts/search alike.

FilingEntity.title: FilingEntity
FilingEntity.description: One quarterly-index row for the accession (primary entity first).

parsed.title: Parsed
parsed.description: Whether this filing's XBRL parsed and contributed to the stitched statements below. False means the stitcher could not read its XBRL, so its periods are absent from the statements and parse_error explains why.

parse_error.title: Parse Error
parse_error.description: Parse-failure detail (exception type and message) when parsed is false; null when the filing contributed.

superseded_by.title: Superseded By
superseded_by.description: Accession of the latest later-filed amendment covering the same report period; null when this filing stands as-is.

FilingXBRLResponse.title: FilingXBRLResponse
FilingXBRLResponse.description:
Per-filing XBRL statements for an explicit accession (filing.xbrl()).

Unlike /financials (which selects the latest 10-K/10-Q via the form chain), this serves
the XBRL statements of ANY single filing addressed by accession - same statement shape,
but no period/amendments/superseded_by (those are company-level selection policy).

superseded_by.title: Superseded By
superseded_by.description: Accession of the latest later-filed amendment covering the same report period; null when this filing stands as-is.

superseded_by.title: Superseded By
superseded_by.description: Accession of the latest later-filed amendment covering the same report period; null when this filing stands as-is.

Form13FData.title: Form13FData
Form13FData.description: filing.obj() for the 13F family - one institutional manager's quarterly holdings report.

Form144AcquisitionDetail.title: Form144AcquisitionDetail
Form144AcquisitionDetail.description: One <securitiesToBeSold> row: how the to-be-sold securities were originally acquired.

Form144Filer.title: Form144Filer
Form144Filer.description: Filer credentials from the form's own headerData (distinct from the SGML cover header).

Form144PriorSale.title: Form144PriorSale
Form144PriorSale.description: One <securitiesSoldInPast3Months> row: a prior Rule 144 sale by the same seller.

Form144SecurityInfo.title: Form144SecurityInfo
Form144SecurityInfo.description: One <securitiesInformation> row: a class of securities proposed for sale + its broker/venue.

total_asset_most_recent_fiscal_year.title: Total Asset Most Recent Fiscal Year

cash_equi_most_recent_fiscal_year.title: Cash Equi Most Recent Fiscal Year

act_received_most_recent_fiscal_year.title: Act Received Most Recent Fiscal Year

short_term_debt_most_recent_fiscal_year.title: Short Term Debt Most Recent Fiscal Year

short_term_debt_prior_fiscal_year.title: Short Term Debt Prior Fiscal Year

long_term_debt_most_recent_fiscal_year.title: Long Term Debt Most Recent Fiscal Year

long_term_debt_prior_fiscal_year.title: Long Term Debt Prior Fiscal Year

cost_goods_sold_most_recent_fiscal_year.title: Cost Goods Sold Most Recent Fiscal Year

cost_goods_sold_prior_fiscal_year.title: Cost Goods Sold Prior Fiscal Year

tax_paid_most_recent_fiscal_year.title: Tax Paid Most Recent Fiscal Year

net_income_most_recent_fiscal_year.title: Net Income Most Recent Fiscal Year

FormCAnnualReport.title: FormCAnnualReport
FormCAnnualReport.description:
annualReportDisclosureRequirements: headcount + two fiscal years of financials + jurisdictions.
Present for the offering forms and C-AR; null for C-TR. edgar coerces blank financials to 0.0.

Field names mirror edgar's exactly (1:1 with the converter) - the `_most_recent_fiscal_year` /
`_prior_fiscal_year` pairs are the current and previous fiscal year as filed.

FormCFilerInfo.title: FormCFilerInfo
FormCFilerInfo.description: headerData/filerInfo: the filer identity + CCC submission credential + routing flags + period.

FormCFundingPortal.title: FormCFundingPortal
FormCFundingPortal.description: The intermediary (registered funding portal / broker) hosting the raise. Null for C-AR/C-TR.

FormCOffering.title: FormCOffering
FormCOffering.description:
offeringInformation: the terms of the crowdfunding offering. Null for C-AR and C-TR.

`offering_amount` / `maximum_offering_amount` are floats: edgar coerces a blank to 0.0, so a
missing target reads 0.0 (not null). The remaining amounts/counts are kept as-filed strings.

FormCSignatureInfo.title: FormCSignatureInfo
FormCSignatureInfo.description:
signatureInfo: the issuer signature plus the individual signer lines.

edgar's derived `signers` (dedup of names -> their titles) is not on the wire; it is recomputable
from `signatures` + `issuer_signature`.

FormDIssuer.title: FormDIssuer
FormDIssuer.description: The entity raising capital (primaryIssuer). Distinct from the SGML cover header.

FormDOffering.title: FormDOffering
FormDOffering.description: The offeringData block: everything about the exempt offering itself.

FormDPerson.title: FormDPerson
FormDPerson.description: One relatedPersonInfo: an executive officer, director, or promoter of the issuer.

FormDSalesCompensationRecipient.title: FormDSalesCompensationRecipient
FormDSalesCompensationRecipient.description: One salesCompensationList/recipient: a broker-dealer or person paid to solicit the offering.

FortyFData.title: FortyFData
FortyFData.description: filing.obj() for a 40-F -- the edgar FortyF.

amt_pay_one_yr_banks_borr.title: Amt Pay One Yr Banks Borr

amt_pay_one_yr_ctrld_comp.title: Amt Pay One Yr Ctrld Comp

amt_pay_one_yr_oth_affil.title: Amt Pay One Yr Oth Affil

amt_pay_aft_one_yr_banks_borr.title: Amt Pay Aft One Yr Banks Borr

amt_pay_aft_one_yr_ctrld_comp.title: Amt Pay Aft One Yr Ctrld Comp

amt_pay_aft_one_yr_oth_affil.title: Amt Pay Aft One Yr Oth Affil

amt_pay_aft_one_yr_other.title: Amt Pay Aft One Yr Other

cash_not_report_in_cor_d.title: Cash Not Report In Cor D

NcenShareClass.title: NcenShareClass
NcenShareClass.description: Identity of one share class (from the SGML header's class-contract block).

OfferingCapitalization.title: OfferingCapitalization
OfferingCapitalization.description: Capitalization table (actual vs as-adjusted); `rows` is the full line-item table as filed.

OfferingDilution.title: OfferingDilution
OfferingDilution.description: Per-share dilution disclosure (chiefly IPO S-1s); all values as-filed strings.

OfferingFeeSecurity.title: OfferingFeeSecurity
OfferingFeeSecurity.description: One security line of a registration fee table (Exhibit 107 EX-FILING FEES).

OfferingFeeTable.title: OfferingFeeTable
OfferingFeeTable.description: Parsed registration fee table -- total registered offering capacity + per-security breakdown.

OfferingSellingStockholder.title: OfferingSellingStockholder
OfferingSellingStockholder.description: One row of a selling-stockholders table (resale registrations); values as filed.

OwnershipData.title: OwnershipData
OwnershipData.description: filing.obj() for Forms 3/4/5 - the edgar Ownership object, full fidelity.

Prospectus424BCoverPage.title: Prospectus424BCoverPage
Prospectus424BCoverPage.description:
424B cover-page fields. Amounts/prices are as-filed strings (may be sentinels like
"at-the-market" / "market-price"); the edgar float accessors are derived, not mirrored.

Prospectus424BData.title: Prospectus424BData
Prospectus424BData.description: filing.obj() for a 424B prospectus (any variant, and /A) -- the edgar Prospectus424B.

Prospectus424BFilingFeeRow.title: Prospectus424BFilingFeeRow
Prospectus424BFilingFeeRow.description: One security row of the EX-FILING FEES XBRL exhibit; all cells as-filed strings.

Prospectus424BFilingFees.title: Prospectus424BFilingFees
Prospectus424BFilingFees.description:
EX-FILING FEES XBRL exhibit (Rule 408, 2022+). Always present; check `has_exhibit` -- when
False every other field is null/empty (no exhibit on ~all 424B1/B4, ~half of 424B2/B5). Amounts
are as-filed XBRL strings, NOT the parsed-float OfferingFeeTable the S-1/S-3 fee_table uses.

Prospectus424BOfferingTerms.title: Prospectus424BOfferingTerms
Prospectus424BOfferingTerms.description: Key-value terms from "The Offering" section; all values as-filed strings.

Prospectus424BPricing.title: Prospectus424BPricing
Prospectus424BPricing.description: Pricing table (price / fee / proceeds). None for ATM and resale filings (no pricing grid).

Prospectus424BPricingColumn.title: Prospectus424BPricingColumn
Prospectus424BPricingColumn.description: One column of the pricing table (e.g. "Per Share" / "Total"); all cells as-filed strings.

Prospectus424BStructuredNote.title: Prospectus424BStructuredNote
Prospectus424BStructuredNote.description: Structured-note key terms (424B2 pricing supplements); all values as-filed strings.

Prospectus497KPerformanceReturn.title: Prospectus497KPerformanceReturn
Prospectus497KPerformanceReturn.description:
One average-annual-returns row (edgar `PerformanceReturn`).

Captured from the backing list rather than the public `performance` DataFrame, which drops
`inception_date`. Returns are parsed percentages (Decimal -> float).

Prospectus497KQuarterReturn.title: Prospectus497KQuarterReturn
Prospectus497KQuarterReturn.description: Best / worst calendar-quarter return: edgar's (Decimal pct, date-text) tuple as a named pair.

Prospectus497KShareClass.title: Prospectus497KShareClass

ProxyAuditFees.title: ProxyAuditFees
ProxyAuditFees.description: Auditor fee disclosure (current vs prior year).

ProxyAwardCloseToMnpi.title: ProxyAwardCloseToMnpi
ProxyAwardCloseToMnpi.description: One equity-award grant made within 4 business days of MNPI disclosure (Item 402(x)).

ProxyBeneficialOwner.title: ProxyBeneficialOwner
ProxyBeneficialOwner.description: One holder row of the beneficial-ownership table (Item 403).

mnpi_disclosure_timed_for_comp_value.title: Mnpi Disclosure Timed For Comp Value

ProxyData.title: ProxyData
ProxyData.description: filing.obj() for the DEF 14A / 14A family - the edgar ProxyStatement object, full fidelity.

ProxyDirectorCompRow.title: ProxyDirectorCompRow
ProxyDirectorCompRow.description: One non-employee-director row of the Director Compensation Table (Item 402(k)).

ProxyExecCompRow.title: ProxyExecCompRow
ProxyExecCompRow.description: One fiscal year of the executive-compensation time series (XBRL ecd: PEO/NEO totals).

ProxyNamedExecutive.title: ProxyNamedExecutive
ProxyNamedExecutive.description: An individual NEO when the pay-vs-performance table is dimensionally tagged per executive.

ProxyPvpRow.title: ProxyPvpRow
ProxyPvpRow.description: One fiscal year of pay-vs-performance metrics (XBRL ecd: facts).

ProxySummaryCompRow.title: ProxySummaryCompRow
ProxySummaryCompRow.description: One executive-year row of the Summary Compensation Table (Item 402(c)).

RegistrationS1Data.title: RegistrationS1Data
RegistrationS1Data.description: filing.obj() for an S-1/F-1 (and /A) -- the edgar RegistrationS1 object, full fidelity.

RegistrationS3Data.title: RegistrationS3Data
RegistrationS3Data.description: filing.obj() for an S-3/F-3 shelf registration (and /A) -- the edgar RegistrationS3, full fidelity.

ReportItem.title: ReportItem
ReportItem.description: One detected item in a periodic report's structural index (text served by /content + /sections).

S1CoverPage.title: S1CoverPage
S1CoverPage.description: S-1 cover-page fields (filer-category + rule checkboxes, SIC/EIN, security description).

S3CoverPage.title: S3CoverPage
S3CoverPage.description: S-3 cover-page fields (filer-category + rule checkboxes, state/EIN). No SIC code on the S-3 cover.

Schedule13DData.title: Schedule13DData
Schedule13DData.description: filing.obj() for SC 13D - active (control-intent) 5%+ beneficial ownership.

Schedule13DItems.title: Schedule13DItems
Schedule13DItems.description: 13D narrative items 1-7 (Item 4, purpose of transaction, is the activist signal).

Schedule13GData.title: Schedule13GData
Schedule13GData.description: filing.obj() for SC 13G - passive (institutional, no control intent) 5%+ ownership.

Schedule13GItems.title: Schedule13GItems
Schedule13GItems.description: 13G items 1-10 (mostly not-applicable flags + the Item 4 ownership block).

Schedule13Issuer.title: Schedule13Issuer
Schedule13Issuer.description: The subject company whose securities are reported.

SixKData.title: SixKData
SixKData.description: filing.obj() for a 6-K -- the edgar SixK, full fidelity (cover metadata + exhibits).

period_months.title: Period Months
period_months.description: Approximate duration in whole months (3=quarter, 12=annual); null for instant periods.

level.title: Level
level.description: Presentation indent depth within the statement hierarchy.

balance.title: Balance
balance.description: XBRL balance attribute of the concept; with weight, determines how the value aggregates.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Calculation-arc weight toward the parent total (e.g. -1.0 subtracts); null when the concept is not in a calculation tree.

preferred_sign.title: Preferred Sign
preferred_sign.description: Display sign multiplier from the presentation linkbase: apply to values to reproduce SEC HTML display (e.g. -1.0 shows outflows as negative). Values ship raw.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Normalized unit: usd, shares, usdPerShare, number, ...

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code when the unit is monetary (incl. per-share); null for shares/pure numbers.

value.title: Value
value.description: RAW XBRL instance value, never sign-adjusted for display: numeric fact, text fact (cover page, flags), or null when absent.

value_type.title: Value Type
value_type.description: Discriminator for value: 'number', 'text', or null when value is null.

level.title: Level
level.description: Presentation indent depth within the statement hierarchy.

balance.title: Balance
balance.description: XBRL balance attribute of the concept; with weight, determines how the value aggregates.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Calculation-arc weight toward the parent total (e.g. -1.0 subtracts); null when the concept is not in a calculation tree.

preferred_sign.title: Preferred Sign
preferred_sign.description: Display sign multiplier from the presentation linkbase: apply to values to reproduce SEC HTML display. Values ship raw. Null when sign_ambiguous.

sign_ambiguous.title: Sign Ambiguous
sign_ambiguous.description: True when periods/filings disagree on this concept's preferred_sign; preferred_sign is then null instead of an arbitrary first-seen pick.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Normalized unit: usd, shares, usdPerShare, number, ...

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code when the unit is monetary (incl. per-share); null for shares/pure numbers.

SubmissionFiling.title: SubmissionFiling
SubmissionFiling.description: One row of the entity's filing history (richer than quarterly-index rows).

unavailable_reason.title: Unavailable Reason
unavailable_reason.description: Why metric is null: 'concept_absent' (no matching concept in the company facts), 'insufficient_quarters' (fewer than 4 consecutive quarters), or 'malformed' (library returned a non-finite value or no unit). Null when metric is present.

public_date.title: Public Date
public_date.description: Latest filing_date across the facts used in the calculation: when this data vintage was fully on file. The library may back a historical window with comparative facts re-reported in later filings, so this is the vintage's publication date, not necessarily the earliest date a TTM for the window was knowable. Null when fact provenance is missing.

TenQData.title: TenQData
TenQData.description: filing.obj() for a 10-Q -- the edgar TenQ, lean structural fidelity.

ThirteenFHolding.title: ThirteenFHolding
ThirteenFHolding.description: One disaggregated information-table row (a security as held via one reporting manager).

ThirteenFOtherManager.title: ThirteenFOtherManager
ThirteenFOtherManager.description: An affiliated manager whose holdings are reported in this consolidated filing.

TwentyFData.title: TwentyFData
TwentyFData.description: filing.obj() for a 20-F -- the edgar TwentyF, lean structural fidelity.
